reason: Both get the ₹394 unit economics and core cuts right, but Output 2 wins on rigor: it differentiates over-claim (retargeting/catalog 0.50 vs prospecting 0.78) instead of a flat 0.72, holds the 5-day UGC test rather than pre-judging and raising its budget, ties scale/cut lines directly to break-even ROAS, fully reconciles spend to the ₹5.6L cap, and flags the GST risk.
